newsitem.title: USA: Figgie backs FY97 pretax EPS $1.80 vs $1.25.
newsitem.headline: Figgie backs FY97 pretax EPS $1.80 vs $1.25.

text.p: Figgie International Inc chairman Jack Reilly said an analyst's 1997 earnings estimate of $1.80 a share is attainable.
"We think that's a reasonable number that is attainable," he said in a telephone interview, adding that the company does not make earnings forecasts.
As reported, Figgie earned $1.25 a share in 1996 versus a net loss in 1995 of $0.89 a share.
Also as reported, Reilly said he resigned as president and chief executive officer to accept another position, but will remain as Figgie's non-employee chairman.
